DOP: carahi ind. [ cf S. tarhi; according to H. Smith, Sadd p. 274, fn 5 : <*tyarhi, cf S. tyad; perhaps for tarahi under influence of several words begining with c- used with an interrogative ], then, at that moment; in that case; yet; (as emphatic particle) then ; Vin II 189, 4 (ayaṃ ~i Devadattassa bhagavati paṭhamo āghāto ahosi, Be, Ce so; Se ayaṃ ca ~i; Ee ayaṃ ca tarahi, prob. wr ); 292, 3 (ayaṃ ~i āyasmato Ānandassa paṭhamaṃ cīvarabhikkhā uppajji cīvarasahassaṃ); M I 330, 2 foll. (handa ~i te mārisa antaradhāyāmī ti, handa ~i me tvaṃ brahme antaradhāyassu sace visahasī ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee handa ca hi); III 128, 26 (ahaṃ ~i te rājakumāra yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, tvaṃ ca me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na ājāneyyāsī ti); A II 119, 1 (kiñcāpi kho idaṃ ṭhānaṃ amanāpaṃ kātuṃ atha carah’ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattatī ti); Ud 11, 7 (ayaṃ ~i tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarākathā hoti vippakatā; Ud-a 104, 29 : ettha ~ī ti nipātamattaṃ); Sn 988 (bhotī ~i jānāti; cf Pj II 582, 24 : bhotī ce jānāti); — commonly used as emphatic particle (preceded by atha ) in interrogative clauses, often expressing exasperation or indignation: who then …? whatever in that case …? why on earth …? esp. in the second clause of a conditional sentence: if …, then who in that case …? if …, then how on earth …? ; Vin I 36, 24* (ettha ca te mano na ramittha … atha ko ~i devamanussa-loke rato mano; Sp 973, 2 : atha ko ~ī ti atha kuhiṃ ~i); 105, 28 (tumhe ce brāhmaṇā uposathaṃ na sakkarissatha … atha ko ~i uposathaṃ sakkarissati); D II 82, 32 (te Sāriputta … sammāsambuddhesu cetopariyañāṇaṃ natthi, atha kiṃ ~i te ayaṃ Sariputta uḷārā āsabhī vācā bhāsitā); 115, 15 (saddahasi tvaṃ Ānanda tathāgatassa bodhin ti, evaṃ bhante ti, atha kiṃ ~i tvaṃ Ānanda tathāgataṃ yāva tatiyakaṃ abhinippīḷesī ti); M I 147, 37 (kimatthaṃ carah’ āvuso bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti); 321, 35 (atha kiṃ ~i tumhe moghapurisā … mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharatha); S IV 47, 8 (no ce kira tvaṃ bhikkhu sīla-visuddhatthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi, atha kimatthaṃ ~i tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsī ti); A V 194, 3 (atha kiṃ ~i bhotā Gotamena vyākatan ti); Ud 7, 7 (atha kho ke ~i sadevake loke arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā ti; cf Ud-a 83, 26 : ke ~ī ti ke etarahi); Sn 999 (kathaṃ ~i jānemu); 1047 (atha ko ~i devamanussaloke atāri jātiṃ ca jaraṃ ca; Pj II 590, 4 foll. : atha idāni ko añño atārī ti); Ja III 312, 2 (sace mayaṃ na vighāsādā atha ke ~i te vighāsādā ti); 315, 9* (atha kiṃ ~i te samma kaṇṭhe kiṇakiṇāyatī ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se kiñci hi te); Ap 535, 11 (kathaṃ ~i sabbaññū vanditabbā tathāgatā); Mil 25,19 (sace … puggalo nūpalabbhati, ko ~i tumhākaṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ deti); Sp 50, 29 (atha kathaṃ ~i bhante sāsanassa dāyādo hotī ti); — carahi in Ee at D III 100, 16 (ettha carahi te) is prob. wr; Be ettha ca hi te; Ce, Se ettha hi te; — see also tarahi.
NCP: indeclinable then at that moment; in that case; yet; (as emphatic particle) then; commonly used as emphatic particle (preceded by atha) in interrogative clauses, often expressing exasperation or indignation: who then ...? whatever in that case ...? why on earth ...? esp. in the second clause of a conditional sentence: if ..., then who in that case ...? if ..., then how on earth ...?
